data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'h-r-a', meaning to be watchful or vigilant. In Islamic contexts, Muhairah refers to a watchful, observant, or protective individual. The name Muhairah carries the meaning “Watchful, Vigilant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muhairah usually hope their child will grow to embody watchful, vigilant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
